rear_self_detection_from_chassis.description: Gate the REAR sector's self-detection by chassis geometry per bearing instead of one scalar threshold, which cannot describe the rear.

min_valid_range_m.description: No-return / invalid reading floor (m). Must sit strictly below RobotSpecs.LIDAR_MIN_RANGE (0.045), since the sensor reports 0.045 for anything closer.

threat_no_detection_range_m.description: beyond this, a sector's nearest reading isn't a threat

no_data_range_m.description: sentinel when a sector has no valid rays at all

blind_wedge_left_min_deg.description: Start bearing (degrees, robot frame) of the rear-left mount-occlusion wedge masked out of the sectors.

blind_wedge_left_max_deg.description: End bearing (degrees, robot frame) of the rear-left mount-occlusion wedge masked out of the sectors.

blind_wedge_right_min_deg.description: Start bearing (degrees, robot frame) of the rear-right mount-occlusion wedge masked out of the sectors.

blind_wedge_right_max_deg.description: End bearing (degrees, robot frame) of the rear-right mount-occlusion wedge masked out of the sectors.

direction_arc_half_fov_deg.description: src.navigation.utils' corner-detection cone -- NOT front_half_fov_deg, see the field's docstring
